experiment: 臨床最近1点の背景質量による属性別有限人口較正
inspiration: after viewing k1 column, k3/k8 and KDE results
C_distance: minimum absolute distance to same-sex C rows
BG_near_count: K=count(abs(q-BGref)<=dC), inclusive boundary; sort absolute distances then searchsorted(side=right)
population: reference same-sex BG rows N; hypothetical sample n=C same-sex row count drawn without replacement from N
probability_implementation: analytic finite-population survival product, accumulated with log1p and expm1; K>N-n implies p=1
smoothing_origin: inherited from prior person calibration; fixed, not selected here
selection: independent within sex, ceil(0.75*q_sex_n), descending evidence then ascending challenge_row_id
interpretation: attribute-wise near-hit probability under hypothetical finite population; not membership probability or calibrated four-column joint p
baseline_scale: phase wholeBG IQR fixed in both contexts, as initial column experiment
null_targets: prelim20 excluding self5; original same-sex without-replacement index function
loto: fixed five candidates in listed order; R_all, each context and prelim20/processed18; tie within1e-12
validation: small math.comb and full subset enumeration
all44 minimum distances and brute BG absolute-distance inclusive counts
